decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Bell shade now has an open upper mouth and smooth taper above the original wood pole and weighted base.

rear.note: Rear shade silhouette is continuous and the offset arm remains attached to the pole.

detail.note: Close detail retains the rolled lower hem and visible wood grain on the pole.

underside.note: Full-size underside shows the inner tapered shade surface and the entering wood support; the deeper socket and bulb are occluded at this angle.

clay.note: Clay retains the original floor-lamp proportions with open shade construction and layered hem.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Clear processing bowl, feed chute and graphite motor base retain their original proportions.

rear.note: Rear handle now forms a continuous bracket joined at the upper and lower bowl positions.

detail.note: Full handle section stays smooth through both rounded corners without the prior hourglass pinch.

underside.note: Closed motor base and original bowl/blade assembly remain attached.

clay.note: Clay confirms the repaired handle shape independently of the transparent bowl.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Clear blender jug and graphite base retain the separate blade, dial and lid details.

rear.note: Rear jug handle is now continuous with connected upper and lower attachments.

detail.note: Rounded handle has a consistent cross section instead of the previously pinched middle.

underside.note: Base underside remains closed and all original controls and jug hardware remain present.

clay.note: Clay preserves the blender silhouette while showing a solid continuous handle.

front.note: Channelled back, white arm pads and five-star base remain unchanged around the repaired seat.

rear.note: Rear shell and arm supports remain connected to the seat and pedestal.

detail.note: Full-size seat detail shows the piping continuously touching the cushion, including its rounded front corners.

underside.note: Underseat mechanism and caster assembly remain separate and connected.

clay.note: Clay confirms the continuous seated welt and unchanged chair proportions.

front.note: Blue free lead follows rounded bends around the orange reel instead of rigid sharp corners.

rear.note: Original rear mounting plate, axle and wound hose remain intact.

detail.note: Guide bar and wound hose remain distinct; the free lead bends smoothly beneath them.

underside.note: Lead now approaches the existing brass quick coupler horizontally and remains connected.

clay.note: Clay preserves the open reel construction with a continuous rounded free hose.

front.note: Upper and lower blade guards now have smooth arcs above the original metal shoe.

rear.note: Rear motor vents, battery and closed trigger handle remain unchanged.

detail.note: Close view shows the broad polygonal guard facets removed; blade and arbor are preserved behind the guards.

underside.note: Shoe, bevel bracket and separate lower guard remain connected with clear depth.

clay.note: Clay confirms smoother guard silhouettes while retaining the original portable saw construction.
